summary: Two hikers suffering excessive altitude illness were rescued from a campground area ~8 miles up Conundrum Creek in the Maroon Bells-Snowmass Wilderness after a relayed Garmin SOS reached dispatch ~12:15 p.m. Saturday; Mountain Rescue Aspen and CareFlight of the Rockies completed the rescue in ~6 hours and both patients were flown to Aspen Valley Hospital for treatment.
responding_agency: Pitkin County Sheriff's Office; Mountain Rescue Aspen; CareFlight of the Rockies
